versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

controles.web: Then Job answered,
controles.kjv: But Job answered and said,
controles.livre: Porém Jó respondeu, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי־זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
controles.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
controles.livre: Ouvi atentamente minhas palavras, e seja isto vossas consolações.

versos.hebraico: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג׃

controles.web: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
controles.kjv: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
controles.livre: Suportai-me, e eu falarei; e depois de eu ter falado, então zombai.

versos.hebraico: הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם־מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא־תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי׃

controles.web: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
controles.kjv: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
controles.livre: Por acaso eu me queixo de algum ser humano? Porém ainda que assim fosse ,por que meu espírito não se angustiaria?

versos.hebraico: פְּנוּ־אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל־פֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
controles.kjv: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
controles.livre: Olhai-me, e espantai-vos; e ponde a mão sobre a boca.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת׃

controles.web: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
controles.kjv: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
controles.livre: Pois quando eu me lembro disto ,me assombro, e minha carne é tomada de tremor.

versos.hebraico: מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם־גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל׃

controles.web: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
controles.kjv: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
controles.livre: Por que razão os perversos vivem, envelhecem, e ainda crescem em poder?

versos.hebraico: זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
controles.kjv: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
controles.livre: Seus filhos progridem com eles diante de seus rostos; e seus descendentes diante de seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
controles.kjv: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
controles.livre: Suas casas têm paz, sem temor, e a vara de Deus não está contra eles.

versos.hebraico: שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל׃

controles.web: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
controles.kjv: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
controles.livre: Seus touros procriam, e não falham; suas vacas geram filhotes, e não abortam.

versos.hebraico: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן׃

controles.web: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
controles.kjv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
controles.livre: Suas crianças saem como um rebanho, e seus filhos saem dançando.

versos.hebraico: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב׃

controles.web: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
controles.kjv: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
controles.livre: Levantam a voz ao som de tamboril e de harpa e se alegram ao som de flauta.

versos.hebraico: יבלו בַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ׃

controles.web: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
controles.kjv: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
controles.livre: Em prosperidade gastam seus dias, e em um momento  descem ao mundo dos mortos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ׃

controles.web: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
controles.kjv: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
controles.livre: Assim dizem a Deus: Afasta-te de nós, porque não queremos conhecer teus caminhos.

versos.hebraico: מַה־שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי־נַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה־נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע־בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
controles.kjv: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
controles.livre: Quem é o Todo-Poderoso, para que o sirvamos? E de que nos aproveitará que oremos a ele?

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃

controles.web: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
controles.kjv: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
controles.livre: Eis que sua prosperidade não se deve às mãos deles. Longe de mim esteja o conselho dos perversos!

versos.hebraico: כַּמָּ֤ה׀ נֵר־רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
controles.kjv: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
controles.livre: Quantas vezes sucede que a lâmpada dos perversos se apaga, e sua perdição vem sobre eles, e Deus em sua ira lhes reparte dores?

versos.hebraico: יִהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי־ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃

controles.web: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
controles.kjv: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
controles.livre: Eles serão como palha diante do vento, como o restos de palha que o turbilhão arrebata.

versos.hebraico: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע׃

controles.web: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
controles.kjv: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
controles.livre: Vós dizeis : Deus guarda sua violência para seus filhos. Que Deus pague ao próprio perverso ,para que o conheça.

versos.hebraico: יִרְא֣וּ עינו כִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
controles.kjv: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
controles.livre: Seus olhos vejam sua ruína, e beba da ira do Todo-Poderoso.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י מַה־חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ׃

controles.web: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
controles.kjv: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
controles.livre: Pois que interesse teria ele em sua casa depois de si, quando o número for cortado o número de seus meses?

versos.hebraico: הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד־דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃

controles.web: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
controles.kjv: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
controles.livre: Poderia alguém ensinar conhecimento a Deus, que julga até os que estão no alto?

versos.hebraico: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו׃

controles.web: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
controles.kjv: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
controles.livre: Alguém morre na sua força plena, estando todo tranquilo e próspero,

versos.hebraico: עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה׃

controles.web: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
controles.kjv: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
controles.livre: Seus baldes estando cheios de leite, e o tutano de seus ossos umedecido.

versos.hebraico: וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה׃

controles.web: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
controles.kjv: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
controles.livre: Porém outro morre com amargura de alma, nunca tendo experimentado a prosperidade.

versos.hebraico: יַ֭חַד עַל־עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
controles.kjv: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
controles.livre: Juntamente jazem no pó, e os vermes os cobrem.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ׃

controles.web: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the devices with which you would wrong me.
controles.kjv: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
controles.livre: Eis que eu sei vossos pensamentos, e os mais intentos que planejais contra mim.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית־נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל׀ מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃

controles.web: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
controles.kjv: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
controles.livre: Porque dizeis: Onde está a casa do príncipe?, e: Onde está tenda das moradas dos perversos?

versos.hebraico: הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
controles.kjv: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
controles.livre: Por acaso não perguntastes aos que passam pelo caminho, e não conheceis seus sinais?

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ׃

controles.web: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
controles.kjv: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
controles.livre: Que os maus são preservados no dia da destruição, e são livrados no dia das fúrias?

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־יַגִּ֣יד עַל־פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֽוּא־עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Who shall declare his way to his face? Who shall repay him what he has done?
controles.kjv: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
controles.livre: Quem lhe denunciará seu caminho em sua face? E quem lhe pagará pelo que ele fez?

versos.hebraico: וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל־גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men shall keep watch over the tomb.
controles.kjv: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
controles.livre: Finalmente ele é levado à sepultura, e no túmulo fazem vigilância.

versos.hebraico: מָֽתְקוּ־ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כָּל־אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

controles.web: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him. All men shall draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
controles.kjv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
controles.livre: Os torrões do vale lhe são doces; e todos o seguem; e adiante dele estão inúmeros.

versos.hebraico: וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשֽׁוּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר־מָֽעַל׃ס

controles.web: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
controles.kjv: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
controles.livre: Como, pois, me consolais em vão, já que vossas em vossas respostas só resta falsidade?
